— On November 16, a formal handover ceremony for newly acquired aviation equipment took place at Modibo Keita International Airport in Bamako, with the equipment being delivered to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa).
The ceremony was attended by Mali's transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, who personally inspected the newly delivered aircraft.
The delivery includes four Mi-8MTV-5 transport helicopters, two Mi-24P attack helicopters, and one Il-76TD transport aircraft.
According to FAMa command, the equipment was purchased using state funds as part of military-technical cooperation with Russia.
